indicator: Standardized Green ICT KPIs and reporting indicators
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a); Clause 11.11(b); Clause 11.11(c); Clause 11.11(d); Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: Operators use different indicators, units, baselines, and levels of quantitative detail for energy efficiency, renewable energy, GHG emissions, and e-waste reporting, limiting consistent measurement and comparison.
rule: If Green ICT performance is reported using inconsistent indicators, units, baselines, or reporting methods that limit consistent measurement and comparison identify an Inconsistent Green ICT Measurement Gap.

indicator: Operator-level GHG emissions and e-waste data
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c); Clause 11.11(d); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Section 14.3
evidence_basis: Operator-level GHG and e-waste information is incomplete or reported with different scopes, measures, classifications, and levels of detail, limiting transparency and evidence-based comparison.
rule: If sufficient operator-level GHG or e-waste information is unavailable or reported using inconsistent scopes, measures, or classifications identify a Missing GHG and E-waste Data Gap.

column9: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a); Clause 11.11(d)
column10: Energy demand and associated emissions remain important operational concerns despite reported energy-efficiency measures, and available operator-level evidence does not consistently demonstrate comparable reductions in energy use and emissions.
column11: If energy demand or associated emissions remain significant despite reported efficiency measures and comparable evidence of improvement is insufficient identify a Rising Energy Consumption and Emissions Gap.

indicator: Physical solar and hybrid renewable-energy deployment
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Sections 5.1.3-5.1.4
evidence_basis: Operators report renewable-energy adoption using different measures, while physical solar and hybrid renewable-energy deployment remains limited or uneven across network infrastructure.
rule: If physical renewable-energy deployment remains limited or uneven across network infrastructure identify a Limited Physical Renewable-Energy Adoption Gap.

policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Clause 11.12; Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: Large-scale renewable-energy procurement depends on supporting regulatory and contractual mechanisms, including CPPA arrangements, and reported implementation challenges can constrain renewable-energy scaling.
rule: If renewable-electricity procurement is constrained by unresolved regulatory, contractual, or supporting mechanisms identify a Renewable Procurement Barrier.

evidence_basis: and other infrastructure-sharing arrangements and benefits
rule: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 5.3
column12: Policy supports infrastructure sharing, but sufficient quantitative operator-level evidence is not available to consistently measure the extent of sharing, shared facilities, or environmental and energy benefits.
column13: If infrastructure sharing is supported by policy but sufficient quantitative evidence is unavailable to assess its extent or resource-efficiency benefits identify an Infrastructure-Sharing Evidence Gap.

column10: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11; Clause 11.12
column11: Differences in responsibilities, coordination, monitoring, reporting practices, and environmental data management can limit consistent implementation of Green ICT measures across operators.
column12: If organizational responsibilities, coordination, monitoring, or accountability arrangements are insufficient to support consistent Green ICT implementation identify an Organizational Implementation Weakness.

column9: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025; Renewable Energy Policy 2025
column10: Several Green ICT requirements and implementation areas require clearer quantitative targets, timelines, operator-level indicators, and verification mechanisms to enable consistent monitoring and assessment.
column11: If policy requirements do not provide sufficiently clear quantitative targets, timelines, indicators, or verification mechanisms for measurable implementation and monitoring identify a Weak Policy Measurability Gap.
